integrity: Proof uses established equivariant Picard, Cartan--Leray, Borel--Moore localization, quotient class group and Reid--Tai results; no numerical experiment is promoted to a proof. No authorship or independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complex coarse symmetric products with integers n,d>=2 only. Integrality claim concerns divisor-degree homology; codimension two can contain nonalgebraic torsion. Local classes are those of completed local rings. Local finite quotient character theorem is prior art; potential implicit historical coverage remains. No external independent validation claimed.
title: Integral divisor classes and collision defects of symmetric projective powers
